description: Main implementation of a sophisticated meta-cognitive retrieval-augmented generation system for multi-phase self-reasoning, including document chunking, query understanding, retrieval strategy, quality assessment, answer synthesis, entity extraction, drift detection, and final answer verification.

classes.name: Chunk
classes.description: Represents a segment of a loaded document, holding its text, metadata, and unique identifier.

classes.name: RankedChunk
classes.description: A Chunk with an associated relevance score used during retrieval ranking.

classes.name: DraftAnswer
classes.description: Represents a preliminary answer generated from retrieved chunks with confidence and gaps.

classes.name: DraftAnswerWithEntities
classes.description: Includes answer text, mentioned entities, and confidence score.

classes.name: VerificationResult
classes.description: Result of claim verification against source chunks, indicating verification status and confidence.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Metadata for a source chunk used as evidence in the final answer.

classes.name: VerifiedAnswer
classes.description: Final answer including citations, overall confidence, and verification summary.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: Atomic factual claim extracted from text for verification.

classes.name: ClaimList
classes.description: A list of Claims.

classes.name: VerificationResult
classes.description: Outcome of claim verification, including verification status and supporting quotes.

classes.name: MatchQuality
classes.description: Assessment of how well a retrieved chunk matches the query criteria.

classes.name: DriftAnalysis
classes.description: Analysis of entity substitution and semantic drift between query and answer.

classes.name: AlignmentVerdict
classes.description: Assessment whether the answer aligns with the query after drift detection.

classes.name: FinalConfidence
classes.description: Computed overall confidence considering all signals and analyses.

classes.name: QuerySemantics
classes.description: Structured analysis of query type, subject, critical terms, and flexibility.

classes.name: PrecisionRequirements
classes.description: Determines needed precision level for retrieval based on query semantics.

classes.name: RetrievalPlan
classes.description: Strategy for retrieving relevant chunks, including primary approach and validation.

classes.name: SubQuestion
classes.description: Atomic sub-question derived from complex queries.

classes.name: SubQuestions
classes.description: A list of sub-questions.

classes.name: Gap
classes.description: Identified missing information in the draft answer.

classes.name: GapList
classes.description: A list of identified gaps.

classes.name: RefinementQuery
classes.description: Search query generated to fill a particular gap.

classes.name: RefinementQueryList
classes.description: A list of queries to refine and improve answer quality.

classes.name: CompleteScore
classes.description: Score indicating how comprehensively the answer addresses the question.

ctags.name: calibrate_confidence
ctags.signature: ( match_qualities: List[MatchQuality], drift_analysis: DriftAnalysis, alignment_verdict: AlignmentVerdict, precision_requirements: PrecisionRequirements, )

ctags.name: completeness_check
ctags.pattern: /^async def completeness_check(answer: VerifiedAnswer, original_question: str) -> float:$/

ctags.name: detect_entity_drift
ctags.signature: ( query_critical_terms: List[str], answer_mentioned_entities: List[str], original_question: str, answer_text: str, )

ctags.name: ensemble_retrieval
ctags.signature: ( question: str, query_type: str, top_k: int = 10 )

ctags.name: evaluate_chunk_match_quality
ctags.signature: ( chunk_text: str, question: str, critical_terms: List[str], precision_level: str, precision_reasoning: str, )

ctags.name: iterative_refinement
ctags.signature: ( question: str, query_type: str, max_iterations: int = 3 )

ctags.name: keyword_retrieval
ctags.signature: ( question: str, chunks: List[Dict], top_k: int = 10 )

ctags.name: lazy_semantic_retrieval
ctags.pattern: /^async def lazy_semantic_retrieval(question: str, top_k: int = 10) -> List[RankedChunk]:$/

ctags.name: query_document
ctags.pattern: /^async def query_document(file_path: str, question: str) -> VerifiedAnswer:$/

ctags.name: type_specific_retrieval
ctags.signature: ( question: str, query_type: str, chunks: List[Dict], top_k: int = 10 )

ctags.name: verify_answer_alignment
ctags.signature: ( original_question: str, answer_text: str, drift_analysis: DriftAnalysis, precision_requirements: PrecisionRequirements, )
